_comment: Few-shot examples for the HR node's intent prompt (plan section 8). Loaded by com.hivecore.llm.FewShots.

Shape: {role, shots:[{question, answer}]}. answer is an IntentSet object: {intents:[{table, metric, column?, group_by?, filters?}]} or {not_relevant:true}, optionally led by "skip" (measures that belong to another node; the parser ignores the key).
Each shot becomes a user turn (the question) and an assistant turn (the answer re-encoded compactly, key order kept). Keep exactly three; mined rows are added at runtime by the evening close.

Kavira Pharmaceuticals tables (staff directory without pay; compensation with the confidential ctc and incentive_paid; branch codes BLR, CHN, KOC). Shot 2 shows the coverage rule on a two-part question: units are not ours (skip), headcount is; there is no month column here, so the time phrase is ignored.

shots.question: Average salary in the Chennai branch
Units sold per branch last quarter, and how many staff per branch?
What were last month's unit sales?
